scope: Read-only consumer/source review; no builds, tests or app modifications.
evidence_level: Source inspection and filesystem/git commands only. Existing tests and roadmap claims were not newly executed or revalidated.

findings.summary: PiezaCAD is the present sibling consumer; historical test_cad path does not exist. Workspace dependencies resolve to live ../truck source, not a git revision pin.
findings.implication: Kernel source changes can affect the next consumer build without a dependency-pin edit. Existing executable build provenance was not checked.

findings.summary: Sketch fillet supports exactly two line/circular-arc entities sharing a PointId. Computes offset intersections, chooses nearest center in positive tangent-bisector halfspace, creates the minor arc, trims endpoints, adds Tangent twice and PointOn.
limitations: Existing test found covers only orthogonal line-line corner radius2; no line-arc or arc-arc execution in this review.
No explicit branch-selection parameter; nearest admissible center is automatic.

Rounding projects feet onto whole unbounded curves and does not call drawn() to constrain feet to retained segments. Oversized radius can extend/reverse short lines; needs regression before claiming valid bounded trimming.

Core fillet inserts tangent/point-on constraints but no radius constraint itself. UI opens a radius dimension editor afterward; persistence after dismissing that editor and upstream edits needs validation.
Constraint references attached to original corner remain on first trimmed endpoint, not original virtual intersection; constrained corner semantics need explicit tests.
future_tests: Reuse line-line test with segments (1,0)->(0,0)->(0,1), radius2. Require immutable rejection or explicitly specified extension behavior; never silently reverse retained segments.
Line-arc: line (10,0)->(0,0), circular arc centered (0,5), endpoints (0,0) and (5,5), r1. Check tangency, contact membership in both original domains, connected region, radius, and reversed storage.
Arc-arc: two circles with centers (0,5) and (5,0), shared endpoint (0,0); choose endpoints on retained quadrants, r0.5. Check branch chosen, both arc domains, retained area and reversed order.

Fully constrained corner: fillet, edit upstream angle/length, cancel radius editor versus commit radius expression, save/reload and undo/redo; require stable intended radius and report conflicting constraints.
NaN/infinity, zero/negative radius, near-collinear sides, third edge at corner, coincident but nonshared PointIds; require deterministic immutable failure and useful UI explanation.

findings.summary: General-curve filleting and explicit multiple-solution choice are absent in current sketch path. ends_at accepts only Line/Arc; parallels returns no candidates for spline and noncircular round geometry.
future_tests: Ellipse-line and cubic-spline-line shared-endpoint fixtures must get explicit unsupported feedback until implemented.
For a circular-arc pair admitting multiple rolling centers, demonstrate current deterministic branch and specify user control for alternate solution before implementing general curves.

findings.summary: No sketch chamfer operation found in sketch implementation or sketch Tool enum. Existing Chamfer is a 3D solid feature, not a sketch corner edit.
future_tests: Add a future line-line sketch chamfer with setbacks2/3, reversed selected sides and non-right angle; retain connected sketch and verify distances.
Future distance-angle sketch chamfer: edit upstream angle while preserving selected-side distance/angle, plus save/load and undo/redo. Requires explicit app implementation authorization.

findings.summary: Adapter separates all straight chains into one group and each curved chain into its own group before common junction dispatch. Mixed straight/curved selections therefore execute sequentially and do not reach the kernel as the complete joined edge set.
findings.implication: New root kernel mixed-corner capability does not by itself establish app support; naming/selection may change after first group. Existing behavior may still succeed for particular geometries, so no universal app failure claimed.
future_tests: Import normalized F1 and H7 production fixtures; select the same three physical edges in app adapter, both orders. Compare direct kernel result versus adapter geometry, radius, material, generated names and unchanged-input failure.
Repeat after upstream size edits and STEP linked-part reload; check stable selections and full selected-set semantics.

findings.summary: 3D document and UI expose one constant fillet radius or two chamfer distances. No variable radius law, per-edge unequal radii, distance-angle mode, throat mode, or stop-face parameter appears in these models.
findings.implication: Kernel support alone cannot close broader F/C/W capability families through current product feature schema.

findings.summary: Adapter retains modified-face names, assigns generated names by selection role and adjacency, resolves references, rejects branching tangent chains, and returns kernel diagnostics. Sketch failure path returns silently when rounding fails.
limitations: Creation roles depend on persistent selection slots; reordering list can change generated names.
General topology-changing naming and arbitrary generated faces require outcome tests; source intent is not proof.
Sketch unsupported/invalid round gives no explanatory feedback in round_corner when fillet returns None.
future_tests: Replay new mixed junction with downstream face/edge feature, edit radius and upstream geometry, preserve roles or report explicit lost reference.
Attempt unsupported spline sketch corner and oversized radius through UI; require diagnostic explaining actionable correction.

findings.summary: Existing tests cover fillet then top chamfer, STEP, upstream boss splitting, names, side assignment and immutable multi-body failure. They were inspected but not executed against current kernel.
future_tests: After kernel checkpoint, run focused core blends tests and native control tests via scripts/headless-test.sh per app instructions; preserve existing uncommitted user work.
Check current Chamfer STEP re-import grouping issue recorded in roadmap on both baseline and current kernel before calling exchange fully complete.

priority: First validate full mixed curved selection through app adapter; it currently partitions selections before junction call.
Establish bounded sketch contact-domain behavior and radius persistence with focused core tests.
Specify/authorize absent sketch chamfer and general-curve/multiple-solution behavior separately from kernel work.
Run existing downstream/naming/STEP/undo scenarios on current local kernel only after build slot and app-work authorization.
